title: Randomized matching verifier
statement: Given Boolean strings $x$ and $r$, let $n$ be the length of the first component decoded from $x$, and form the Boolean adjacency matrix of size $n$ from the second decoded component. The verifier accepts exactly when $x$ is the prescribed encoding of that matrix, the random string has length at least $n^2$ times the prescribed number of sampling bits for $n$, and the determinant of the matrix obtained by applying the prescribed Lovász construction to the matrix and the sample from $r$ is nonzero.
caveat: The component decodings, matrix construction, encoding, sampling-bit count, Lovász construction, and sampling procedure are not defined in the supplied material.
